featured.title: Nepal Flood Death Toll Surges Past 330 as Glacier Collapse Scale Becomes Clear
featured.excerpt: Scientists confirm an ice-rock avalanche, not an earthquake, triggered one of Nepal's worst natural disasters, with over 900 people still missing including dozens of Americans and 177 Indian pilgrims.
featured.image_caption: An aerial view shows houses buried under mud and debris following flash floods in Nepal on August 26, 2026. The floods killed over 330 people and left more than 900 missing across eight districts.
featured.nri_angle: 177 Indian pilgrims en route to Kailash Mansarovar are among the missing, 63 Americans unaccounted for, and downstream flooding prompted evacuations in Bihar — the disaster has direct implications for diaspora families across South Asia.
featured.author: Diaspora Desk

editorial.title: Who Is Vishal Sikka? The AI Pioneer Who Ran Infosys — and Just Raised $85 Million to Disrupt It
editorial.excerpt: Nine years after a bruising exit from Infosys, the 59-year-old former SAP CTO has founded Hang Ten Systems, an enterprise AI startup that closed $85 million in seed funding in four months — with Intel and Micron's CEOs writing checks.
editorial.image_caption: Vishal Sikka speaking at SAP's SAPPHIRE conference in Orlando in 2010, when he was the company's first-ever CTO. In 2026 he founded Hang Ten Systems, an enterprise AI startup that has raised $85 million in seed funding.
editorial.nri_angle: Sikka's arc — small-town Madhya Pradesh to Stanford mentorship under AI's founding fathers to the top of Infosys and SAP, and now a founder again at 59 — embodies the Indian diaspora's outsize role in the AI era.
editorial.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Google's $899 Googlebooks Bet on Android Loyalty Faces the Real Test
just_in.excerpt: Google's Android-based Googlebooks start at $899 in October with Gemini AI baked in — but the real question is whether a billion Android users will trust Google with their laptop.
just_in.image_caption: A Googlebook laptop. Google’s new Android-based laptops start at $899 and launch in October, with Gemini AI built into the operating system.
just_in.nri_angle: India, overwhelmingly an Android market, is where the loyalty Googlebooks needs lives — whether students, developers and professionals there buy into a Google-centric laptop will decide the product's fate as much as US reception.

just_in.title: SpiceJet Under DGCA Watch as Minister Flags Cash Crisis, Safety Risks
just_in.excerpt: Civil Aviation Minister Ram Mohan Naidu said the government is monitoring the cash-strapped carrier's operations and finances to ensure "no lapse in safety," while noting limits to state intervention.
just_in.image_caption: A SpiceJet aircraft on the tarmac. India’s aviation ministry has placed the cash-strapped carrier under operational and financial scrutiny through the DGCA.
just_in.nri_angle: SpiceJet's survival matters for competition on diaspora-heavy India routes, where fewer carriers mean higher fares; travelers with bookings should watch schedules and consider refundable fares through the winter rush.

just_in.title: Student Learns to Walk and Talk Again After Accidental Paracetamol Overdose
just_in.excerpt: Riley Lubas, 20, suffered multiple organ failure after unknowingly doubling up on paracetamol. After life support and months of rehab, he is walking and talking again.
just_in.image_caption: Riley Lubas with his mother Kate at King’s College Hospital in London. The 20-year-old suffered multiple organ failure after accidentally overdosing on paracetamol and had to relearn to walk and talk.

just_in.title: L.A. County Hits 100 West Nile Cases, Highest in Nearly a Decade

just_in.image_caption: An image accompanying coverage of the West Nile virus surge in Los Angeles County. The county has reported 100 infections in 2026, its highest count in nearly a decade.

just_in.title: Measles Exposure at Philadelphia Airport Triggers Alert Amid National Surge

news.title: How NRIs Can Lower the 30% TDS on Indian Rental Income and Claim Refunds
news.excerpt: Tenants must withhold 30% on rent paid to NRI landlords — but deductions, a lower-TDS certificate under Section 197, and a timely tax return can recover most of it.
news.image_caption: Residential high-rises in Mumbai. NRI landlords face 30% tax deducted at source on rental income from Indian property.
news.nri_angle: Addresses one of the most common tax pain points for NRIs with property in India — a 30% upfront withholding that is frequently recoverable through lower-TDS certificates and refunds.

news.excerpt: The exclusive private-market partnership will make India's first approved dengue vaccine available for pediatric and adult vaccination in the first half of 2027, with Dr Reddy's handling promotion and distribution while Takeda retains manufacturing and public-market rights.
news.image_caption: Dr. Reddy's signage at its Technology Development Centre. The company won exclusive private-market rights to distribute Takeda's QDENGA dengue vaccine in India.

news.title: Mortgage Rates Near 7% as Fed Hike Squeezes Homebuyers Ahead of Midterms
news.excerpt: The 30-year fixed mortgage rate climbed to 6.95% this week, its highest since January 2025, as the Federal Reserve's first rate increase in three years snuffed out hopes of borrowing relief — pushing housing affordability to the center of the midterm debate.
news.image_caption: A 'sold' sign outside a suburban American home. Mortgage rates near 7% are squeezing homebuyers ahead of the midterms.
news.nri_angle: Indian-American buyers, heavily concentrated in high-cost metros like the Bay Area, New York, and Seattle, face some of the nation's steepest affordability hurdles as rising rates combine with already-elevated home prices.

news.image_caption: The main gate of IIT Bombay in Powai. The institute suspended a professor's deanship and apologised for a statement on a student's death.
news.nri_angle: The IITs are the alma mater of much of the diaspora's engineering diaspora and the aspiration of NRI parents; the welfare and disciplinary-fairness debate mirrors conversations on US and European campuses where diaspora students study.

news.image_caption: Minneapolis Fed President Neel Kashkari, who said U.S. inflation remains too high across all sectors.
news.nri_angle: Kashkari is one of the most prominent Indian-Americans in U.S. economic policymaking, and his hawkish stance directly shapes borrowing costs for diaspora families with mortgages, small businesses and education loans.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.image_caption: Mount Manaslu in Nepal, where an avalanche buried a tent at Camp III, killing two climbers.

nri-world.nri_angle: IIT Bombay is the alma mater of tens of thousands of Indian-origin engineers in the US — its governance, campus culture and handling of caste and mental-health issues are personal to the diaspora.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Cricket Frenzy Grips Indian and Pakistani Expatriates Across the Gulf
nri-world.excerpt: From Friday-morning games on Riyadh's open grounds to crowded restaurants during India-Pakistan clashes, cricket remains the cultural lifeline of South Asian expatriates — and Saudi Arabia is building a sporting future around it.
nri-world.image_caption: Sharjah Cricket Stadium, a popular venue for matches drawing large South Asian expatriate crowds in the Gulf. Cricket frenzy is gripping Indian and Pakistani expatriates across the Gulf.
nri-world.nri_angle: For millions of Indian and Pakistani workers in the Gulf, cricket is home in portable form — and Saudi Arabia's cricket push could soon give their children a national team of their own.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Indian-American Conservatives Face Racial Gatekeeping From the MAGA Fringe
nri-world.excerpt: A Times of India report and U.S. coverage document racially charged attacks on Indian-American conservatives — from Ramaswamy's Ohio bid to Nikki Haley and JD Vance's family — even as immigration enforcement tightens around the community.
nri-world.image_caption: The U.S. Capitol in Washington, D.C. Indian-American conservatives say they face racial gatekeeping from parts of the MAGA movement.
nri-world.nri_angle: Indian-Americans across party lines are learning that political alignment does not shield them from racial gatekeeping — while immigration enforcement tightens around the community.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: JioHotstar Goes Global: Ambani Targets Diaspora in UK, Canada, Singapore
nri-world.excerpt: JioHotstar replaces Hotstar in Britain, Canada and Singapore with 160,000+ hours of content across 12 languages — but no live sports at launch, and pricing runs about ten times Indian plans.
nri-world.image_caption: Mukesh Ambani's JioHotstar is expanding beyond India to target the diaspora in the UK, Canada and Singapore.
nri-world.nri_angle: JioHotstar's first overseas launch puts 160,000+ hours of Indian content in 12 languages directly in front of diaspora households in the UK, Canada and Singapore.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: After Years in America, an NRI Came Home — and Felt He Didn't Belong
nri-world.excerpt: NDTV reported the account of an NRI who moved back after years in the United States and now describes loneliness and disconnection: "I feel like I don't belong here." The story reflects a wider, often unspoken strain among returning Indians.
nri-world.image_caption: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport in Mumbai. After years in America, one NRI came home — and found he no longer felt he belonged.
nri-world.nri_angle: For NRIs weighing a return, this story underscores that repatriation is an emotional transition as much as a logistical one — belonging must be rebuilt, not just revisited.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: Salem Advocate Earns Rare Federal Credential to Defend Immigrants in Court
immigration.excerpt: Jessica Jennings of Lutheran Community Services Northwest is the organization's first fully accredited representative — one of just 11 in Oregon — a credential that lets her take asylum and deportation cases before immigration judges.

sources.label: Safe Route Immigration (Lutheran Community Services Northwest)

immigration.nri_angle: Oregon's immigrant communities, including diaspora families, gain a rare local source of affordable asylum and deportation defense inside immigration court at a moment of intensifying federal enforcement.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: Ottawa Sets 90-Day Deadline for Atlantic Immigration Applicants With Job Changes
immigration.excerpt: New IRCC officer instructions end the old practice of parking Atlantic Immigration Program files on hold: applicants with employment changes now get a 90-day document deadline, and officers must refuse applications that miss it.
immigration.image_caption: Parliament Hill in Ottawa, with the Peace Tower flying the Canadian flag. Federal immigration instructions published July 23, 2026 set a 90-day deadline for Atlantic Immigration Program applicants who change jobs or whose employer changes ownership.
immigration.nri_angle: Thousands of Indian workers and international-student graduates in Atlantic Canada use the AIP for permanent residence; a job change mid-application now triggers a 90-day paper deadline that, if missed, means outright refusal.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: Australia Rewrites Skilled Visa Processing Priorities in Two New Ministerial Directions
immigration.excerpt: Ministerial Directions 121 and 122, signed on 18 September and in force from 19 September, put construction, healthcare, teaching, agriculture and resources workers at the front of the queue — and end the old penalty for offshore applicants in priority occupations.
immigration.image_caption: Parliament House in Canberra, Australia. Two new ministerial directions rewrite how skilled visa applications are prioritised.
immigration.nri_angle: Australia's large Indian professional community and applicants still in India benefit directly: offshore priority-sector applicants now rank equally with onshore applicants, removing a long-standing disadvantage for Indians hired by Australian employers while living in India.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: Trump Turned a Refugee Bureau Into a $410 Million Deportation Machine
immigration.excerpt: A Washington Post investigation reveals the State Department's new "Office of Remigration" has committed at least $410 million to secret deals with 31 countries to accept deportees who aren't their citizens.
immigration.image_caption: US President Donald Trump turned a refugee bureau into a $410 million deportation machine.
immigration.nri_angle: With refugee and asylum pathways shrinking while the deportation apparatus grows, Indian nationals caught in US immigration limbo face a new risk: removal not to India, but to a third country they may never have visited, where their legal options are thinner.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: Salazar Says Trump Was 'Receptive' After She Warned Hispanic Voters Feel Betrayed
immigration.excerpt: The Florida Republican, in a rare GOP break with the president, told CBS she had a "very good conversation" with Trump after her campaign ad said his immigration enforcement had "gone too far."
immigration.image_caption: Rep. María Elvira Salazar, who said President Trump was 'very receptive' to her warning about Hispanic voters.
immigration.nri_angle: Salazar's distinction between criminals and working families speaks directly to Indian diaspora concerns — H-1B workers, students, and mixed-status families living under an enforcement regime that increasingly sweeps up people with no criminal record.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: Selling Property in India as an NRI? The TDS Rules Are Very Different
immigration.excerpt: NRI sellers face TDS under Section 195 on the full sale price from the first rupee — not the 1% rule residents get. A Section 197 certificate can bring the deduction down to the actual gain.
immigration.image_caption: Residential apartment buildings in Mumbai. NRIs selling property in India face TDS rules very different from those for resident sellers.

sources.label: Medium — TDS on sale of property by an NRI (Section 195)
NBA Office — Capital Gains Tax on Sale of Property by NRIs
Nitin J Shetty CA — TDS on sale of property by NRI

immigration.nri_angle: NRIs selling property in India face a far heavier TDS regime than residents; knowing the Section 197 certificate route can keep lakhs in cash from being locked up until refund.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: US Expands Social Media Vetting to Media and USMCA Visas From Oct 1
immigration.excerpt: Starting October 1, applicants for I, TN, and TD visas must set all social media profiles to public, as the State Department extends its online-presence review to three more nonimmigrant visa categories.
immigration.image_caption: A U.S. passport sits beside a U.S. visa foil bearing entry stamps. The State Department will expand its social media vetting program to I, TN, and TD visa applicants effective October 1, 2026.
immigration.nri_angle: Indian journalists on I visas face the new public-profiles requirement, while Indians can obtain TD visas as dependents of TN holders; H-1B workers are already under social media vetting.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Simply Wall St's Top Founder-Led Stocks to Watch in September: Paytm, Marico and Lenskart
markets-finance.excerpt: Founder-led Indian companies are back in focus as borrowing costs stay firm. Simply Wall St's September 2026 screen spotlights Paytm's profitability turnaround and UPI tailwind, Marico's copra-driven margin recovery, and Lenskart's post-IPO momentum.
markets-finance.image_caption: The National Stock Exchange in Mumbai. A new report names Paytm, Marico and other founder-led companies among the stocks to watch in September.
markets-finance.nri_angle: A global investor read on three founder-led Indian companies in payments, consumer goods and retail, with no diaspora-specific angle.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Indian-Origin Founders Built $560 Billion of Unicorn Value Abroad, Report Finds
markets-finance.excerpt: The Prosus-Dealroom Indian Diaspora Index found 205 overseas unicorns with at least one founder who grew up in India — worth more than the $349 billion attributed to 102 India-based unicorns.
markets-finance.image_caption: Silicon Valley, looking south toward downtown San Jose. A new report finds Indian-origin founders built $560 billion of unicorn value abroad.
markets-finance.nri_angle: The index quantifies the diaspora's outsized role in global tech value creation, with Indian-origin founders driving $560 billion of unicorn value mostly from the US.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: CLSA Holds Course on TCS, Infosys, HCLTech as Nifty IT Slides Third Day
markets-finance.excerpt: The brokerage warned that cautious demand commentary, geopolitics, higher interest rates and inflation could weigh on Indian IT earnings, as the Nifty IT index fell for a third straight session.
markets-finance.image_caption: The Infosys campus in Mysuru. CLSA held its course on TCS, Infosys and HCLTech as the Nifty IT index slid for a third straight day.
markets-finance.nri_angle: Indian IT stocks are core holdings for many diaspora portfolios, and CLSA's sustained Hold stance signals the large caps may stay range-bound until earnings reaccelerate.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: India-New Zealand FTA Takes Effect Oct. 20 With Zero-Duty Indian Exports
markets-finance.excerpt: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal and his New Zealand counterpart confirmed the October 20 start date after both countries completed ratification, opening duty-free access for every Indian export to New Zealand.
markets-finance.image_caption: New Zealand Trade and Investment Minister Todd McClay and India’s Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal shake hands during trade talks, with the flags of both countries behind them. The ministers announced on September 21 that the India–New Zealand free trade agreement will enter into force on October 20, 2026.
markets-finance.nri_angle: Indian exporters — including MSME owners in the diaspora who source or distribute through India — gain zero-duty access to New Zealand from October 20, with engineering goods the biggest beneficiary.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: IPL Worth $20.6 Billion as Private Equity Reshapes Cricket Business
markets-finance.excerpt: Houlihan Lokey values the IPL at $20.6 billion after a record year of franchise sales and a media-rights boom, as global investors pile into what is becoming sport's most lucrative asset class.
markets-finance.image_caption: An editorial illustration shows the IPL logo with a batsman silhouette amid falling Indian 500-rupee notes and golden confetti. Houlihan Lokey's 2026 valuation pegs the league's business at $20.6 billion.
markets-finance.nri_angle: The IPL's nearly one-billion-strong global audience includes a large North American viewership that has made the league a prime-time fixture for Indian diaspora households.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: 100% Tariff Threat Sharpens India's Push for Trade Deals Beyond the U.S.
markets-finance.excerpt: With Washington poised to authorize tariffs of up to 100% on Russian oil buyers, India is racing to diversify through new trade pacts with the UK and EU — but economists doubt they can quickly replace the American market.
markets-finance.image_caption: Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal gestures while speaking at an industry event in New Delhi. Goyal is steering India's push for new trade deals as the US threatens tariffs of up to 100% on top buyers of Russian energy.
markets-finance.nri_angle: Indian-American investors and small businesses sourcing from India face rising costs and portfolio exposure as tariffs climb, while the UK and EU pacts may redirect where Indian exporters sell.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Hyderabad Leads India's Record GCC Boom With 40 New Centres
markets-finance.excerpt: India added 111 new global capability centres in the first eight months of 2026, already beating 2025's full-year record — and Hyderabad took the top slot ahead of Bengaluru.
markets-finance.nri_angle: India's GCC boom offers returning-NRI tech professionals globally branded employers and dollar-grade work, with salary premiums narrowing the gap to US levels in scarce skills.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: AI Buildout Overtakes Housing as America's Top Investment Engine
markets-finance.excerpt: Real spending on data centers and computer hardware hit $752 billion in the second quarter, surpassing residential investment for the first time — a milestone that shows where the economy's confidence now sits.
markets-finance.image_caption: A data center facility. AI infrastructure buildout has overtaken housing as America's top investment engine.
markets-finance.nri_angle: Indian-Americans are heavily represented in the technology sector driving this buildout, from hyperscaler engineering teams to data-center construction and semiconductor supply chains, making the shift a direct read on the industry many in the community work in.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Stock Futures Edge Up After Dow's Third Straight Weekly Loss
markets-finance.excerpt: Index futures pointed to a modestly higher open early Monday as investors steadied after the Dow's worst week since March, with oil prices and the coming Trump-Xi summit setting the week's tone.
markets-finance.image_caption: The trading floor of the New York Stock Exchange.
markets-finance.nri_angle: Many Indian-American households hold diversified U.S. equity exposure through 401(k)s and brokerage accounts, so a volatile September shaped by rates and oil prices directly affects year-end retirement balances.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Blackstone Says India Is Nearing a Tipping Point for Foreign Capital
markets-finance.excerpt: Jon Gray told Bloomberg Television that India now generates Blackstone's best private-equity returns in the world — a reversal from the years it "did basically nothing" there.
markets-finance.image_caption: A Blackstone sign stands outside one of the firm's offices. Blackstone executives say India is nearing a tipping point for foreign capital inflows.
markets-finance.nri_angle: For NRI investors weighing India allocations, Blackstone's verdict reframes the trade: the world's largest alternative asset manager says India has moved from a long-dated demographic promise to its best-performing private-equity market on actual returns.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: India set for 'unparalleled' decades-long growth, says Tata chief Chandrasekaran
markets-finance.excerpt: Speaking at Sai University's convocation in Chennai, the Tata Sons chairman said AI would create industries that don't exist today and told graduates to treat careers as marathons — while arguing India's economic rise could run for decades.
markets-finance.image_caption: N Chandrasekaran, chairman of Tata Sons, speaks at a podium against a purple backdrop. Addressing Sai University's convocation in Chennai, he said India is entering a period of economic growth unparalleled in its history.
markets-finance.nri_angle: The Indian diaspora weighs investing and building back home against opportunities abroad, and Chandrasekaran's decades-long India growth outlook frames where that overseas capital and talent flow next.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: India's exports to China jump 39% as core BRICS shipments rise 34% to $19.9 billion
markets-finance.excerpt: Commerce ministry data show shipments to China, South Africa, Brazil and Russia reached $19.9 billion in the first five months of the fiscal year, lifting the bloc's share of India's export basket to 9.2%.
markets-finance.image_caption: A container ship loads cargo at the Hai Phong International Container Terminal. India's exports to China rose 39% in April–August 2026-27 on engineering goods, electronics and petroleum products.
markets-finance.nri_angle: India's record export run and its growing BRICS footprint strengthen the rupee's earnings base, which supports NRI remittance value and diaspora investment confidence.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: India Retain Asian Games Women's Cricket Gold With Record 147-Run Win Over Sri Lanka
sports.excerpt: Smriti Mandhana's 45-ball 79 — and a record 216 for 3 — powered India to a crushing 147-run victory over Sri Lanka in the final, the country's first gold of the 2026 Asian Games.
sports.image_caption: An India batter plays a shot during the women's cricket final against Sri Lanka at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games. India won the final by 147 runs to retain the gold medal, the country's first gold of the 2026 Games.
sports.nri_angle: A second straight Asian Games gold — and India's first medal of the 2026 Games — gives the global Indian diaspora a marquee win to rally around, with Mandhana's record 11,000 international runs adding a historic individual milestone.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: India Thrash Korea 63-31 to Stay Unbeaten at Asian Games
sports.excerpt: A day after routing hosts Japan, India's kabaddi men dominated South Korea 63–31 in Nagoya to make it two wins from two in their title defence at the 2026 Asian Games.
sports.image_caption: Action from the India vs South Korea men's kabaddi match at the 2026 Asian Games. India won 63-31 at the Tokai Citizens Gymnasium in Nagoya on September 22 to stay unbeaten in Group A.
sports.nri_angle: Kabaddi is India's indigenous sport, and the men's ruthless title defence at the Asian Games — watched by a global diaspora — is one of the purest Indian success stories on the continental stage.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: India Face Japan in Historic First-Ever T20I at Sano
sports.excerpt: World No. 1 India warm up for the Asian Games against 41st-ranked Japan in a first-ever men's T20I at Sano, branded the Suzuki Cup — after rain washed out India's practice session and with no reserve day available.
sports.image_caption: Indian players celebrate during a T20 International. The reigning T20 World Cup champions face Japan in a first-ever men's T20I at the Sano International Cricket Ground on Tuesday 22 September, branded the Suzuki Cup.
sports.nri_angle: For the Indian diaspora in Japan — one of Asia's fastest-growing Indian communities — Tuesday's match is a rare homecoming of Indian cricket on Japanese soil, while fans in India get a morning fixture that doubles as a cultural bridge between two partner nations.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: India Chases Cricket Gold as Sindhu Leads Packed Asian Games Day 4 Schedule
sports.excerpt: Harmanpreet Kaur's women face Sri Lanka for T20 gold at 10:30 AM IST on September 22, while PV Sindhu's badminton squad meets hosts Japan and shooters Parth Mane and Elavenil Valarivan target a medal.
sports.image_caption: PV Sindhu at a felicitation ceremony after her Olympic silver medal. Sindhu faces Japan in her Asian Games 2026 badminton tie on September 22.
sports.nri_angle: Indian fans in Japan and streaming worldwide get their first full day of medal action, with the cricket final at a diaspora-friendly mid-morning IST slot.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: Chennai Super Kings Name Zaheer Khan Head Coach for IPL 2027
sports.excerpt: The five-time IPL champions ended Stephen Fleming's 16-year coaching era, handing former India pacer Zaheer Khan his first head-coach role on a one-year contract.
sports.image_caption: Zaheer Khan at a public event in Mumbai. The former India pacer has been named head coach of Chennai Super Kings for IPL 2027, succeeding Stephen Fleming after 16 years.
sports.nri_angle: CSK's enormous diaspora fanbase gets a new era to follow, with the franchise's US-based Texas Super Kings still searching for a coach of its own.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: India Women Face Sri Lanka for Gold in Asian Games Cricket Final
sports.excerpt: Harmanpreet Kaur's defending champions meet Sri Lanka for the Asian Games women's cricket gold at 10:30 AM IST on September 22, while boxer Sakshi Chaudhary opens against an Olympic medallist.
sports.image_caption: Members of the Indian women's cricket team during a match at the Asian Games. India faces Sri Lanka in the women's gold medal match on September 22 at Aichi-Nagoya.
sports.nri_angle: For Indian-Americans, the women's cricket final airs at a convenient 10:00 PM PDT on Monday, September 21, and stars like Harmanpreet Kaur and Smriti Mandhana draw heavy diaspora viewership.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: Suchika Tariyal Wins Historic Bronze as MMA Debuts at Asian Games
sports.excerpt: The 36-year-old lost a disputed overtime semifinal to Singapore's Teo Hui Hoon but leaves Aichi-Nagoya with India's first Asian Games medal in mixed martial arts.
sports.image_caption: Suchika Tariyal holds the Indian flag aloft after her Brave CF 92 debut victory in December 2024. The 36-year-old won bronze in the women's traditional -60kg event at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games on Monday, India's first-ever MMA medal at the Games.
sports.nri_angle: India's first Asian Games MMA medal arrives as the sport surges in global popularity, giving diaspora fight fans a homegrown name to follow on the international circuit.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: Praggnanandhaa Downs Giri as India Beat Netherlands at Chess Olympiad
sports.excerpt: R Praggnanandhaa declined a draw offer from Anish Giri and ground out his first win in Samarkand as the defending champions beat the Netherlands 3-1 — but India's top-seeded women lost 1.5-2.5 to Poland for the third straight Olympiad.
sports.image_caption: R Praggnanandhaa defeated Anish Giri as India beat the Netherlands at the Chess Olympiad.
sports.nri_angle: The Rameshbabu siblings starred for India on opposite ends of a mixed day, and the top-board win came against Dutch No. 1 Anish Giri, born to a Nepali father in Russia.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: India Rout Japan 49-24 to Open Kabaddi Title Defence at Asian Games
sports.excerpt: Ashu Malik's three-point Super Raid set the tone as debutants starred in a dominant opening group-stage win at Nagoya's Tokai Citizens Gymnasium.
sports.image_caption: India's men's kabaddi team poses for a group photograph on the mat in their blue India jerseys. The defending champions opened their Asian Games 2026 title defence with a 49-24 win over hosts Japan in Nagoya.
sports.nri_angle: Kabaddi's Pro Kabaddi League has built a growing US fanbase; India's title defence gives diaspora viewers a team to follow through the Asian Games.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: Asian Games 2026: India Joint 10th After Day 1 as China, Japan Lead
sports.excerpt: India opened its Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games medal account with two shooting silvers from Elavenil Valarivan, while China and hosts Japan set the early pace with 20 medals each.
sports.image_caption: The Asian Games 2026 medal standings graphic from Aichi-Nagoya, Japan. India ended Day 1 joint 10th after winning two shooting silvers.
sports.nri_angle: For Indian fans watching from the United States and elsewhere abroad, the medal table is the daily scoreboard that matters most — Day 1's joint-10th place is a starting point, with athletics, wrestling and boxing still to come.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: Umesh Yadav Parts Ways With Vidarbha, Takes NOC to Play for Another State
sports.excerpt: The 38-year-old pacer told The Indian Express the Vidarbha Cricket Association gave him no clarity on his future, prompting his departure ahead of the 2026-27 Ranji Trophy season.
sports.image_caption: Umesh Yadav celebrates a wicket with his teammates during a match. Yadav has secured an NOC from the Vidarbha Cricket Association and will represent another state from this season.
sports.nri_angle: Umesh Yadav's journey from Nagpur's streets to 170 Test wickets without formal academy training has long inspired diaspora cricket communities, and his refusal to quit at 38 keeps that story alive for young fast bowlers abroad.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: Mandhana tops women's T20I run charts as India crush Bangladesh to reach Asian Games final
sports.excerpt: Smriti Mandhana passed Suzie Bates with a 19-ball 37 in the Asian Games semifinal, while Shafali Verma's unbeaten 49-ball century powered India to a 114-run win and a gold-medal clash with Sri Lanka.
sports.image_caption: Smriti Mandhana. She topped the women's T20I run charts as India beat Bangladesh to reach the Asian Games final.
sports.nri_angle: Mandhana's records travel: she sits atop every all-time women's T20I chart diaspora kids will find first, a readymade role model as women's cricket fights for visibility abroad.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Google's $899 Googlebooks Bet on Android Loyalty Faces the Real Test
technology.excerpt: Google's Android-based Googlebooks start at $899 in October with Gemini AI baked in — but the real question is whether a billion Android users will trust Google with their laptop.
technology.image_caption: A Googlebook laptop. Google’s new Android-based laptops start at $899 and launch in October, with Gemini AI built into the operating system.
technology.nri_angle: India, overwhelmingly an Android market, is where the loyalty Googlebooks needs lives — whether students, developers and professionals there buy into a Google-centric laptop will decide the product's fate as much as US reception.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Infosys Cleared in AI Worker's 'Sham' Contract Case in Australia
technology.excerpt: Australia's Fair Work Commission ruled the AI expert's engagement was a standard three-way labour-hire arrangement, rejecting her claim that Infosys was her true employer.
technology.nri_angle: The ruling carries weight for Indian tech professionals in Australia, many of whom work through labour-hire chains on sponsored visas — and now know host companies carry legal distance in dismissal claims.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: India's 'AI 100' Names 100 Agency Leaders Reshaping Brands With AI
technology.excerpt: Indian Startup Times has published "The AI 100: Agency Leaders Redefining Brands with AI," an editorial list recognizing 100 agency and marketing leaders across India who are bringing artificial intelligence into brand building — from creative technologists and prompt-engineering-certified tech leads to veteran media planners.
technology.image_caption: A photo collage of headshots of Indian advertising and marketing leaders, arranged around the Indian Startup Times logo. Indian Startup Times uses the collage for its editorial list features recognizing leaders across India's agency and marketing ecosystem.
technology.nri_angle: For the Indian diaspora in marketing and advertising abroad, the AI 100 maps India-based counterparts operating at the same scale — including Publicis Global Delivery leaders running global media operations from India — and sits alongside TIME100 AI 2026's ten Indian-origin honorees as a marker of Indian AI talent's global footprint.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: 'Soul-Sucking' AI Coding Post Goes Viral as Elon Musk, Top Tech Leaders Weigh In
technology.excerpt: An anonymous engineer's X post describing his Claude Code-driven job as 'soul-sucking' — 'Nobody knows anything here,' he wrote — drew millions of views and responses from Elon Musk, Chamath Palihapitiya, and GitLab's CEO, reopening the debate over what AI is doing to software work.
technology.image_caption: A visitor walks past a large illuminated AI sign at a technology exhibition. The viral post argued that AI coding tools have reduced engineers to button-pushers, drawing responses from Elon Musk and other tech leaders.
technology.nri_angle: India's vast software workforce — including thousands of diaspora engineers at US tech companies — faces the same AI-driven productivity pressure the viral post describes, making the debate over developer agency and deskilling deeply personal for the community.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: The IIT Delhi Engineer Behind Apple's Foldable iPhone Duo
technology.excerpt: Piyush Pratik, an IIT Delhi graduate turned Apple product manager, holds a leadership role on the iPhone Duo — Apple's first foldable iPhone and its most expensive model ever.
technology.image_caption: Piyush Pratik, an Apple product manager for iPhone. His LinkedIn profile lists him as Product Manager, iPhone Duo, placing him in the leadership team for Apple's first foldable iPhone, unveiled on September 9, 2026.
technology.nri_angle: An IIT Delhi alumnus now holds a leadership role on Apple's most ambitious iPhone in years — a visible marker of how central Indian-origin engineers have become to flagship Silicon Valley hardware.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Indian American Founders Raise $24 Million to Build AI Workforce for Lenders
technology.excerpt: Kastle's Series A round, led by Insight Partners, will fund AI agents that work across banks' existing systems. Co-founders Rishi Choudhary and Nitish Poddar say the agents have already processed $1.8 billion in transactions.
technology.image_caption: The San Francisco financial district. Kastle, a San Francisco startup founded by Rishi Choudhary and Nitish Poddar, raised $24 million in Series A funding led by Insight Partners to build AI agents for consumer lenders.
technology.nri_angle: Kastle was founded by Indian American entrepreneurs Rishi Choudhary and Nitish Poddar, continuing the diaspora's strong presence in enterprise AI and fintech leadership.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Swiss Physicists Fire 'Atomic Cannon' to Test Einstein's Gravity Rule
technology.excerpt: Researchers at ETH Zurich and the Paul Scherrer Institute have produced an intense, precisely controlled beam of muonium atoms — opening the first path to measuring gravity's pull on second-generation matter.
technology.image_caption: Two researchers align the cryogenic apparatus used to produce the muonium beam at the Paul Scherrer Institute. The beam could allow the first measurement of how gravity acts on matter dominated by a second-generation particle.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Oracle Layoffs Hit Abilene, the 'Flagship' Site of Its OpenAI Stargate Deal
technology.excerpt: The Times of India reports the layoffs have reached the flagship Stargate data center in Abilene, Texas — the site Oracle keeps citing as proof its OpenAI deal is on track — as the company cuts up to 30,000 jobs to fund a $50 billion AI buildout.
technology.image_caption: Oracle's headquarters. Layoffs hit the company's Abilene, Texas site, the flagship of its OpenAI Stargate deal.
technology.nri_angle: Oracle employs thousands of Indian engineers in the US and India, and reported India cuts of ~3,000 jobs make this layoff wave a direct bread-and-butter concern for the diaspora tech workforce.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Stellantis Takes Full Control of Thiruvallur Plant, Targets 160% Output Jump
technology.excerpt: The automaker bought out CK Birla Group's stake in its 2017 joint venture and will more than double the Tamil Nadu plant's workforce as it ramps output toward 50,000 units, with exports taking the lead.
technology.image_caption: A Stellantis plant. The automaker has taken full control of its Thiruvallur facility and targets a 160% output jump.
technology.nri_angle: Stellantis's export-led expansion widens opportunities for Indian-origin auto engineers and underscores India's manufacturing story for diaspora investors.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Apple Cuts Fitness+ Audio Jobs in Second Layoff Round in Two Months
technology.excerpt: The cuts hit the audio team behind Time to Walk and Time to Run and come amid reports the workout service may eventually fold into a redesigned Health app.
technology.image_caption: An Apple marketing image shows Fitness+ workout sessions playing across an iPad, iPhone, and Apple Watch, with on-screen workout metrics. Apple cut a “handful” of Fitness+ roles this past week, its second round of layoffs in less than two months, according to Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman.
technology.nri_angle: Indian professionals are heavily represented across Apple's software and health teams, so restructuring inside Cupertino lands close to home — while the Apple Watch health ecosystem remains a staple of health-conscious Indian-American families.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Musk Pitches 200-Mph Hyperloop Tunnel Between Austin and San Antonio
technology.excerpt: The Boring Company founder says the 80-mile Texas tunnel would cut a drive that can take 2.5 hours to under 30 minutes — but revealed no route, cost, or timeline.
technology.image_caption: Elon Musk, in a dark suit and tie, steps out of an elevator. Musk said on Sunday that The Boring Company is working on a 200-mph “precursor Hyperloop” tunnel between Austin and San Antonio.
technology.image_credit: Benjamin Fanjoy / Getty Images via TechCrunch
technology.nri_angle: Austin's booming Indian tech community — thousands of Indian engineers across Tesla, SpaceX, Boring, and X in nearby Bastrop — sits directly on the corridor Musk wants to tunnel under, making this Texas infrastructure bet a local story for the diaspora.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Vaishnaw warns chip industry to brace for cyberattacks as India's semiconductor push accelerates
technology.excerpt: The Electronics and IT minister says India's new chip-making capability will be seen as a threat by established players, even as five units reach commercial production and global CEOs finalise India investments.
technology.image_caption: Ashwini Vaishnaw. The Union minister warned the chip industry to brace for cyberattacks as India's semiconductor push accelerates.
technology.nri_angle: India's chip push is drawing investment and talent globally, and a secure, credible semiconductor ecosystem gives diaspora engineers and startup founders a serious reason to build with India.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

entertainment.title: Kalki 2 Locks Pan-India Star for Cameo as Prabhas Sequel Wraps 30% of Shoot
entertainment.excerpt: Nag Ashwin's follow-up to the 2024 blockbuster has quietly finalized a pan-Indian actor for a special cameo, with nearly a third of filming done — while Amitabh Bachchan and Kamal Haasan, who never shared the screen in the first film, may finally appear together.
entertainment.image_caption: Prabhas as the bounty hunter Bhairava in a still from Kalki 2898 AD. The sequel, Kalki 2, has wrapped 30 percent of its shoot and locked a pan-Indian actor for a cameo, according to Pinkvilla.
entertainment.nri_angle: The Indian diaspora, a major driver of overseas grosses for big Telugu and pan-India blockbusters, will be tracking the sequel's casting reveals and production milestones closely as anticipation builds abroad.
entertainment.author: Diaspora Desk

entertainment.title: Raaka Sets Guinness World Record With 37 Simultaneous Motion-Capture Performers
entertainment.excerpt: Allu Arjun and Atlee's sci-fi epic was certified by Guinness World Records on September 15 for capturing 37 performers in real time — a first for a film production of this scale.
entertainment.image_caption: Allu Arjun and director Atlee pose with the Guinness World Records certificate on stage in Mumbai. Their film Raaka set the record for 37 performers in simultaneous motion capture.
entertainment.nri_angle: The Guinness record gives the diaspora a global-scale technical milestone to rally around, positioning Raaka as Indian cinema's next big-canvas spectacle with certified proof of its ambition.
entertainment.author: Diaspora Desk

entertainment.title: Daayra’s Tepid Weekend: ₹4 Crore Haul Marks Kareena Kapoor’s Lowest in 15 Years
entertainment.excerpt: Meghna Gulzar's investigative thriller, starring Kareena Kapoor Khan and Prithviraj Sukumaran, collected an estimated ₹4.10–4.50 crore net in its first three days — with a flat Sunday showing no growth.
entertainment.image_caption: Promotional poster for Daayra shows Prithviraj Sukumaran as DCP Raman Kumar in a police uniform alongside Kareena Kapoor Khan as DCP Ajooni Kohli, with yellow police barricade tape in the background. The Meghna Gulzar-directed thriller collected an estimated ₹4.10–4.50 crore net in its opening weekend.
entertainment.nri_angle: NRIs in the US, UK and Gulf markets — where Kareena Kapoor Khan and Prithviraj Sukumaran both have strong followings — could still lift Daayra's fortunes, as overseas collections often cushion Hindi films with slow domestic starts.
entertainment.author: Diaspora Desk

entertainment.title: Karan Johar to Make Film on R&AW Founder R.N. Kao, Sets August 2028 Release
entertainment.excerpt: The Dharma Productions feature, based on Nitin Gokhale's 'Gentleman Spymaster,' will trace Kao's journey from 1955 to the 1971 war, timed to R&AW's 60th anniversary.
entertainment.image_caption: Karan Johar will make a film on R&AW founder R.N. Kao, set for release in August 2028.
entertainment.nri_angle: R.N. Kao is a towering but little-known figure for many NRIs; the film could become the definitive mainstream introduction to the founder of India's external intelligence agency.
entertainment.author: Diaspora Desk

entertainment.title: 'Angh' Wins TIFF Platform Award, Earns Path to 2027 Oscars Race
entertainment.excerpt: Theja Rio's debut feature — the only Indian film in TIFF's auteur-driven Platform competition — becomes eligible for the Oscars' International Feature race under new Academy rules.
entertainment.image_caption: Konyak Naga community members in Nagaland. Theja Rio's film Angh is set among the Konyak people and is spoken almost entirely in the Konyak language.
entertainment.nri_angle: For the Indian diaspora — especially North-East Indians and the large South Asian audience at TIFF — 'Angh' puts Nagaland's culture and a first-time Indian director on one of world cinema's biggest stages.
entertainment.author: Diaspora Desk

entertainment.title: Gondhal: Marathi Folk Thriller Selected as India's Oscar Entry for 2027
entertainment.excerpt: The Film Federation of India has chosen Santosh Davakhar's Marathi thriller Gondhal — selected from 33 submissions — as India's official entry for the 99th Academy Awards' Best International Feature Film category.
entertainment.image_caption: A folk performer in a bull mask in a scene from Gondhal. The Marathi thriller has been selected as India's official entry for the 2027 Academy Awards.
entertainment.nri_angle: Most Marathi Oscar entries have been nearly impossible to find with subtitles outside India — but Gondhal's seven-language dubbed versions give diaspora viewers in the US, UK and Gulf a genuine chance to watch India's official pick before the ceremony.
entertainment.author: Diaspora Desk

entertainment.title: Ajay Devgn's Two ₹50-Crore Shots: Drishyam 3 and Golmaal 5 Eye Historic Openings
entertainment.excerpt: Ajay Devgn has two 2026 releases left — Drishyam 3 on October 2 and Golmaal 5 — and both carry expectations of a historic ₹50-crore opening day, a feat only Shah Rukh Khan and Hrithik Roshan have managed twice.
entertainment.image_caption: Ajay Devgn. His upcoming releases Drishyam 3 and Golmaal 5 are tracking toward historic 50-crore opening days in India. (Photo: Wikimedia Commons / CC BY-SA 4.0)
entertainment.nri_angle: Opening-day records are no longer decided in India alone — diaspora audiences in the US, UK and Gulf contribute a meaningful share of Bollywood's biggest starts, and Devgn's core overseas family audience will be central to any ₹50-crore bid.
entertainment.author: Diaspora Desk

entertainment.title: Kunal Kemmu's 'Vibe' Jumps on Day 2, Beats 'Madgaon Express' Two-Day Total
entertainment.excerpt: The spy comedy earned an estimated ₹2.5–2.8 crore net on Saturday, pushing its two-day total past Kunal Kemmu's directorial debut and setting up a projected ₹7.5–8 crore opening weekend.
entertainment.image_caption: Kunal Kemmu. His film 'Vibe' jumped on day two, beating 'Madgaon Express' two-day total.
entertainment.nri_angle: Preity Zinta's return and a pop-culture-driven spy comedy travel well with NRI audiences; like Madgaon Express, the film's real diaspora moment may come on streaming via its Amazon MGM Studios pipeline.
entertainment.author: Diaspora Desk

entertainment.title: Mammootty's Cameo Fails to Lift 'Law & Order' Past ₹47 Lakh in Two Days
entertainment.excerpt: The Malayalam cop drama opened to ₹29 lakh and dropped to ₹18 lakh on day two, leaving its domestic total under ₹50 lakh despite a high-profile promotional pivot around Mammootty's special appearance.
entertainment.image_caption: Mammootty. His cameo in 'Law & Order' failed to lift the film past ₹47 lakh in two days.
entertainment.nri_angle: Malayalam diaspora audiences in the Gulf and North America skipped the film as negative word of mouth travelled fast; its only meaningful second act will be a quick streaming release for those viewers.
entertainment.author: Diaspora Desk

entertainment.title: Rahul Bhatt Revisits Strained Bond With Father Mahesh Bhatt
entertainment.excerpt: In a new Indian Express feature, Rahul Bhatt reflects on growing up with an absent father — echoing his father Mahesh Bhatt's own account of a childhood without a father figure.
entertainment.image_caption: Rahul Bhatt in a photograph from around the time of his 2012 interviews. The celebrity fitness trainer has spoken repeatedly about his strained relationship with his father, filmmaker Mahesh Bhatt, a rift revisited this week by The Indian Express.
entertainment.nri_angle: The Bhatts' story is Bollywood-specific but the themes — absent fathers, divorce, and whether a parent owes money, presence or both — play out in Indian families everywhere, including across the diaspora.
entertainment.author: Diaspora Desk

entertainment.title: Ayesha Kapur Returns to Bollywood 17 Years After 'Black'
entertainment.excerpt: The actor, who won a Filmfare Award at 11 for playing young Michelle in Sanjay Leela Bhansali's 'Black,' returns to the big screen in 'Om Ka Hari' — telling Hindustan Times the post-'Black' chatter once derailed her decision-making.
entertainment.image_caption: Ayesha Kapur with husband Adam Oberoi at their March 2025 wedding in Delhi, in a photo montage that includes a still of her as young Michelle in Black. Kapur has returned to Hindi cinema after a 17-year gap with the family drama Om Ka Hari.
entertainment.nri_angle: Born in Germany, raised in Auroville, educated in New York and now acting in Mumbai, Kapur's cross-continental life mirrors the diaspora experience — and her candid account of child stardom and adult interference resonates with parents navigating a talented child's ambitions.
entertainment.author: Diaspora Desk

entertainment.title: Deepika Padukone and Ranveer Singh Welcome Their Second Daughter
entertainment.excerpt: The couple announced the birth of their second daughter, born September 19, in a joint social media post signed "Dua, Deepika & Ranveer" — crediting their first daughter, Dua, born in September 2024, with welcoming her baby sister.
entertainment.image_caption: Ranveer Singh and a pregnant Deepika Padukone pose together in a black-and-white maternity photoshoot. The couple announced the birth of their second daughter, born September 19, 2026, in a joint social media post signed Dua, Deepika and Ranveer.
entertainment.nri_angle: The couple counts among the most-followed Indian cultural figures globally, and their family milestones travel instantly through diaspora networks — resonating with parents abroad balancing careers and young families.
entertainment.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: Should You Get a COVID Shot This Fall? The 2026–27 Vaccines Are Here
lifestyle-health.excerpt: Four updated vaccines targeting the XFG variant won FDA approval for the 2026–27 season, with eligibility centered on older adults and people with underlying conditions.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: For Indian-American households planning fall gatherings and India trips, booking the updated shot weeks before holiday travel gives protection time to build — especially for grandparents and immunocompromised family members.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: Konkona Sen Sharma Shares Dengue Recovery Update From Hospital Bed
lifestyle-health.excerpt: The actor posted a hospital-bed photo on Instagram, told followers she is 'better now,' and was back at Lust Stories 3 promotions by Sunday.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: Konkona Sen Sharma shared a dengue recovery update from her hospital bed.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: Dengue remains a seasonal risk for diaspora travellers visiting India during the monsoon months — a reminder from an unlikely public-health messenger.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: Measles-exposed Amtrak traveler rode through six California counties
lifestyle-health.excerpt: An unvaccinated passenger later hospitalized with measles traveled by train and bus through six counties Sept. 12–14; L.A. Union Station visitors from Saturday 8 a.m.–noon should monitor symptoms through Oct. 3.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: A close-up shows the red, blotchy measles rash spread across a person’s neck and upper chest. California health officials are warning of measles exposure across six counties after an unvaccinated Amtrak passenger traveled through the state Sept. 12–14.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: With Diwali travel weeks away, California's Indian diaspora families — frequent Amtrak and air travelers — should check MMR vaccination status before heading to busy stations or traveling to India.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: At 81, This Gurugram Grandmother Is Still Travelling, Working — and Fully Confident
lifestyle-health.excerpt: A viral Instagram video by Gurgaon-based founder Mehar Toor shows her 81-year-old grandmother — a businesswoman fresh off an Alaska cruise — explaining her philosophy in one line: she feels fully confident she can go anywhere.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: An 81-year-old Gurugram grandmother pictured with her granddaughter, startup founder Mehar Toor. The dadi, a businesswoman and avid traveller, recently returned from an Alaska cruise.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: For diaspora families who track their elders' health across time zones, this dadi flips the script — a gentle challenge to every family that has quietly decided what an 81-year-old can and cannot do.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: Raise Your Sum Insured or Buy Riders? How Experts Say to Prioritise
lifestyle-health.excerpt: A cheap super top-up can take family cover to Rs 1 crore for about Rs 4,500 a year - but riders like consumables cover and critical-illness protection still earn their place. Here is how to prioritise.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: A hospital exterior. Experts say the ideal target is about ₹1 crore of total health cover, and a super top-up is usually the cheapest way to raise it.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: A live question for NRIs insuring aging parents in India: a super top-up is the cheapest way to bring an old Rs 5 lakh policy up to a realistic level.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: PFRDA Finalises NPS Swasthya: 25% Medical Withdrawal Cap, Health Cover Up to Rs 30 Lakh
lifestyle-health.excerpt: The pension regulator's September 18 guidelines spell out how much NPS Swasthya subscribers can draw for healthcare, the mandatory four-tier family-floater insurance, and what happens if a renewal premium goes unpaid.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: India-domestic product; the natural diaspora audience is NRIs planning retirement in India, though NRI eligibility details were not spelled out in the guidelines' published summaries.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Jaipur's Amber Terrace Named Among World's 25 Best New Hotel Restaurants
food.excerpt: Amber Terrace, the rooftop Pan-Asian lounge at The Leela Palace Jaipur, is the Indian entry on Travel + Leisure's ranking of the world's 25 best new hotel restaurants, chosen from 120 venues across 17 countries.

food.title: Parag Milk Foods to Invest ₹100 Crore, Quadruple Paneer Capacity to 80 Tonnes a Day
food.excerpt: The dairy maker will expand plants in Maharashtra and Andhra Pradesh by June 2027, betting on the shift from unorganized to branded paneer. Paneer has grown 28% for the company in two years.
food.image_caption: Rows of fresh paneer cubes move along a production line at a dairy plant. Parag Milk Foods plans to quadruple its paneer capacity to 80 metric tonnes per day by June 2027 with a ₹100 crore investment.
food.nri_angle: Branded Indian paneer is expanding globally — Parag's Dairy Valley brand recently launched in UK supermarkets — so the capacity expansion supports the diaspora's growing access to familiar, high-quality dairy.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: High-Protein Spinach Paneer Wrap Packs 26g Protein in 460 Calories
food.excerpt: Instagram food creator Shagun Malhotra shared her paneer wrap recipe on September 17 — spiced paneer slabs and crunchy vegetables inside a spinach-based wrap, aimed at vegetarians trying to stay fitter in their 30s and beyond.
food.image_caption: A paneer wrap filled with spiced paneer, lettuce and sliced vegetables. The photo illustrates the recipe Instagram creator Shagun Malhotra posted on September 17, which she says packs 26 g of protein into 460 kcal.
food.nri_angle: Protein intake is a common worry for Indian vegetarian families abroad, and this wrap offers a familiar, home-cookable answer at a claimed 26 g per serving.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Kachoris and Coffee: Why Food Has Become the New Fuel for India's Run Clubs
food.excerpt: Across Indian cities, post-run kachoris, modak and tiramisu have turned sunrise runs into the new social outing for a sober-curious generation.
food.image_caption: An India Today illustration shows runners alongside modaks, kachoris and tiramisu. India's run clubs are pulling in members with post-run food spreads, from dawn kachori runs to tiramisu meetups.
food.nri_angle: Diaspora run clubs already end long runs at dosa joints and chai carts, and NRIs visiting India can use local run clubs as a low-barrier way to build a social circle.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Diwali Sweets Will Cost More as Ghee, Sugar and Dry Fruit Prices Climb
food.excerpt: Sweet shops across India are preparing to pass on surging ingredient costs this festive season — and shoppers may pay more or get smaller boxes.
food.image_caption: Indian sweets displayed at a mithai shop. Sweet makers expect festive-season prices to rise as much as 15% as sugar, milk, ghee and dry fruit costs climb.
food.nri_angle: NRIs celebrating Diwali abroad face the same squeeze — mithai in Edison, London or Dubai costs more to make and gift this season.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: The Sando Project brings Japanese milk-bread sandos to Chennai and Puducherry
food.excerpt: Ciclo Café's limited-time Sando Project menu piles Indo-Chinese chilli chicken, bibimbap paneer and beef fillet with mustard into thick, in-house Japanese milk bread across Chennai and Puducherry.
food.image_caption: Japanese milk bread. Ciclo Café's limited-time Sando Project menu builds sandos on in-house shokupan in Chennai and Puducherry.
food.nri_angle: For diaspora families visiting Chennai or Puducherry this season, The Sando Project is a fresh, limited-time stop worth adding to the eating itinerary between home cooking and old favourites.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: From Curry Clubs to Beer Gardens: Indian Food Finds Home in English Pubs
food.excerpt: From village pubs in Worcestershire to London locals hosting Diwali parties, Indian food festivals are drawing crowds to some of England's most traditional drinking spots.
food.image_caption: A traditional pub interior. Indian food festivals and curry nights are increasingly finding a home in pubs across England, from Wetherspoon's Thursday Curry Club to London Diwali celebrations.
food.nri_angle: The pub curry night is one of the most visible ways Indian food culture has woven itself into everyday British life — and a reminder of the diaspora restaurateurs and traders behind it.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Diwali 2026: India's Best Places to Experience the Festival of Lights
travel.excerpt: From a million diyas on Varanasi's ghats to the Golden Temple mirrored in light, here is where Diwali 2026 will be most spectacular — plus when to book before fares spike.
travel.image_caption: Diyas float on the Ganges during Dev Deepawali in Varanasi — the "Diwali of the gods" held two weeks after Diwali. Diwali 2026 falls in early November.

travel.title: India Warns Against Using Visa-Free Malaysia Entry to Find Jobs
travel.excerpt: India's High Commission in Kuala Lumpur says it has seen a "noticeable increase" in travellers misusing the 30-day visa-free facility to seek work, warning of overstay, exploitation, detention and legal action.
travel.image_caption: A busy daytime street in Kuala Lumpur's Bukit Bintang district, with billboards and the elevated monorail line. India has warned travellers against using Malaysia's visa-free entry to seek work.
travel.nri_angle: Malaysia is home to one of the largest Indian-origin populations in Southeast Asia, and many job-seekers from India are drawn there — the advisory warns that legal employment requires a work permit or VDR, not a tourist entry.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Nayanthara's ₹8 Lakh Maldives Weekend Shows the Cost of a Water Villa
travel.excerpt: The actor's holiday photos from Patina Maldives put a number on the island's top-tier luxury — a two-night stay in a Sunset Water Pool Villa runs close to ₹8 lakh, while the resort's entry-level villas cost about a third of that.
travel.image_caption: Nayanthara in a yellow dress on a Maldives beach. Her two-night water-villa getaway cost roughly ₹8 lakh, according to the report.
travel.nri_angle: For Indian travelers, Nayanthara's Maldives trip is a reminder that the island's famous prices span a wide band — celebrity-tier water villas run close to ₹4 lakh a night while beach pool villas at the same resort cost about a third of that.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Diwali Airfare Surge: Delhi–Bengaluru Tickets Cross ₹20,000 as Festival Rush Squeezes Seats
travel.excerpt: A viral post spotlighting a ₹13,000-to-₹20,000+ jump on the Delhi–Bengaluru route has become the face of this year's festive fare surge, as tighter seat capacity, costlier jet fuel and dynamic pricing collide ahead of the November 8 festival.
travel.image_caption: An Air India aircraft in flight during peak festive-season travel. Delhi-Bengaluru fares for Diwali have surged past Rs 20,000, up from around Rs 13,000, prompting complaints from travellers about festive pricing.
travel.nri_angle: NRIs combining international trips with domestic legs — or booking family members' festive-season travel within India — face the same Diwali fare surge, making early booking of domestic connections the simplest hedge.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Etihad Cancels Delhi-Abu Dhabi Flight EY217, Stranding 200 After Mid-Boarding Snag
travel.excerpt: Passengers had already boarded the Boeing 787-9 on Saturday night when the crew reported a technical issue; the cancellation was confirmed only after hours of waiting, disrupting onward connections through Etihad's Abu Dhabi hub.
travel.image_caption: An Etihad aircraft. The airline cancelled Delhi-Abu Dhabi flight EY217 mid-boarding, stranding around 200 passengers.
travel.nri_angle: Abu Dhabi is a key transit hub for US–India diaspora travellers, and a cancelled late-night feeder flight like EY217 unspools onward itineraries to Europe and North America — making clear airline communication, not just rebooking, the real test for visa-constrained travellers.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Vande Bharat Drone Video Captures Jharkhand's Hills Looking Like Switzerland
travel.excerpt: A viral aerial clip shows the saffron-and-grey Vande Bharat Express threading through dense forests and rolling hills on the Barkakana–Ranchi line, prompting viewers to compare India's heartland with the Swiss Alps.
travel.image_caption: A Vande Bharat Express train photographed near Mumbai. The viral drone video that sparked comparisons with Switzerland was filmed on the Barkakana–Ranchi line in Jharkhand.
travel.nri_angle: Jharkhandi and Bihari diaspora communities abroad get a reframed visual identity of home, with the viral clip circulating in community groups and shaping trip planning.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Seven places Bollywood stars keep returning to that aren't Goa or Maldives
travel.excerpt: Beyond Goa and the Maldives, Bollywood's most loyal holiday rituals play out in London, Gstaad, Dubai, New York, Paris, Bali and Kashmir — a star-tested itinerary any traveller can borrow.
travel.image_caption: The Manhattan skyline rises above the trees of Central Park in New York City. New York is one of seven destinations Bollywood stars return to year after year, beyond the usual Goa and Maldives getaways.
travel.nri_angle: Most of the stars' ritual destinations — London, New York, Dubai, Paris — are direct flights from US gateways, so diaspora travellers can lift this itinerary wholesale for their own next holiday.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: UPI Now Works in 10 Countries as NPCI Expands Its Global Acceptance List
travel.excerpt: From Bhutan in 2021 to Cambodia and Greece in 2026, Indian tourists can scan and pay with familiar UPI apps abroad - with in-app activation, Rs 2 lakh European limits, and uneven merchant acceptance to plan around.
travel.image_caption: A smartphone displays the UPI logo beside a QR-code payment stand, with global landmarks in the background. UPI now works for merchant payments in 10 countries, and NPCI has expanded its Global Acceptance enablement list further in 2026.
travel.nri_angle: UPI abroad is directly useful to NRIs and frequent travellers; separately, NRIs in the US, Canada, UK, UAE, Singapore and Australia can link international mobile numbers to NRE/NRO accounts for transfers to India.

carousel.nri_angle: Thousands of Indian workers and international-student graduates in Atlantic Canada use the AIP for permanent residence; a job change mid-application now triggers a 90-day paper deadline that, if missed, means outright refusal.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: SpiceJet Under DGCA Watch as Minister Flags Cash Crisis, Safety Risks
carousel.excerpt: Civil Aviation Minister Ram Mohan Naidu said the government is monitoring the cash-strapped carrier's operations and finances to ensure "no lapse in safety," while noting limits to state intervention.

carousel.title: India Retain Asian Games Women's Cricket Gold With Record 147-Run Win Over Sri Lanka
carousel.excerpt: Smriti Mandhana's 45-ball 79 — and a record 216 for 3 — powered India to a crushing 147-run victory over Sri Lanka in the final, the country's first gold of the 2026 Asian Games.
carousel.image_caption: An India batter plays a shot during the women's cricket final against Sri Lanka at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games. India won the final by 147 runs to retain the gold medal, the country's first gold of the 2026 Games.
carousel.nri_angle: A second straight Asian Games gold — and India's first medal of the 2026 Games — gives the global Indian diaspora a marquee win to rally around, with Mandhana's record 11,000 international runs adding a historic individual milestone.

carousel.title: Google's $899 Googlebooks Bet on Android Loyalty Faces the Real Test
carousel.excerpt: Google's Android-based Googlebooks start at $899 in October with Gemini AI baked in — but the real question is whether a billion Android users will trust Google with their laptop.
carousel.image_caption: A Googlebook laptop. Google’s new Android-based laptops start at $899 and launch in October, with Gemini AI built into the operating system.
carousel.nri_angle: India, overwhelmingly an Android market, is where the loyalty Googlebooks needs lives — whether students, developers and professionals there buy into a Google-centric laptop will decide the product's fate as much as US reception.
